verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's docs include a dedicated 'Official SDKs for integrating Hyperbrowser into your applications' section. The introduction offers control via 'our SDKs' alongside Puppeteer/Playwright, and the sandbox docs tell users to set up the SDKs, with code samples like `sandbox.exec(...)`. missing for 10: named supported languages and SDK reference depth in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
